sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the correct QUDT QuantityValue encodings, owners, paths, datatypes, units, four-case cardinality, evidence, and midpoint tolerance approach. Repair the maximum-selection SPARQL: remove the three equality FILTER NOT EXISTS blocks, which currently reject valid data whenever any subregion equals the selected maximum and therefore require every case value to equal it. For each of F, Q, and P, reject only when a case value is greater than the selected value beyond tolerance, and separately require that at least one of the four corresponding case values matches the selected maximum within a tolerance scaled from the expected selected result (not from the reported case value); equality with one or more cases must pass. Keep this as a bounded direct-arithmetic maximum check.
